# Code of Conduct

> 🌐 Language / Ngôn ngữ: **English** | [Tiếng Việt](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.vi.md)

Be respectful, technical, evidence-oriented, and constructive. Do not harass, threaten, discriminate, publish private information, or deliberately disrupt project discussions.

This applies to issues, pull requests, reviews, release discussions, and other project spaces controlled by the maintainer.

Private conduct concerns: `Đăng Khoa <i.am@dangkhoa.dev>`.
